Hi Liam —

Thanks again for confirming Redwood for the pilot. To get Sprint 0 moving, propose we lock a 90min kickoff next week to:
- align goals and success criteria for the pilot (P0/P1).
- confirm host+guest attendee roster and on-call lanes for the first two weeks.
- run through the Sprint 0 playbook (attached) and signal any blocked items.

Candidate slots (PT):
1) Tue Sep 7 | 10:00–11:30
2) Wed Sep 8 | 13:00–14:30
3) Thu Sep 9 | 09:00–10:30

Please pick one or reply with alternatives. Attendees we plan to include: your product lead (Liam), your IT/Security (we asked for an SSO/SSO test contact), Redwood: Ben (onboarding lead), Monica (CS), Karthik (infrastructure/runbook).

Agenda (high level):
- 0–10m: intros & success metrics
- 10–30m: Sprint 0 scope and sequencing
- 30–55m: Roles, on-call lanes, escalation paths
- 55–80m: Access, SSO, and security checklist (Anya — can you confirm SSO contact?)
- 80–90m: Next steps & owner commit

Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Calendar invite will be sent once we have a slot. I attached the Sprint0_Playbook_v1.pdf — please skim section 2 (access checklist) before the call.

Thanks,
